title: Grateful Dead Live at Central Park on 1969-06-22
lineage: AUD low gen (complete show) + SBD MC > C > D > CD

ai_review.summary: Muddy audience recording of an ultra‑high‑energy Central Park gig, with smoking jams like “Silver Threads & Golden Needles” and “Me & My Uncle.”
ai_review.review: The tape is a classic lo‑fi audience capture – full of hiss, mud and even some loud obscenities – but beneath the noise lies a barn‑burning performance. Reviewers rave about the hot jams, especially the pedal‑steel‑laced “Silver Threads & Golden Needles” and “Me and My Uncle,” while noting that the audio fidelity is far from pristine.

ai_rating.rationale: Show quality is consistently praised as high‑energy with standout songs, but recording quality is described as muddy and noisy; the weighted average yields a solid 4‑star rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Very lo‑fi: prominent hiss, mud, occasional dropouts, and extremely loud audience obscenities. Despite the noise, reviewers say the jams still come through.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Loose, free‑concert vibe with a flowing set that keeps the energy high despite the recording's roughness.
